reason: The cited evidence confirms that Cr16Mn16Fe16Co16Ni16P20 has complex crystallization (E2) and that laser ablation can achieve ~10^12 K/s cooling rates (E4), but no evidence is provided to support the key premise that nitrogen incorporation occurs or that it stabilizes the amorphous phase; E1 and E3 are irrelevant to these specific claims.
